name: digit_copy
description: Copy the first digit of a numeric identifier; matched control copies an explicit label digit.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
items=[];control=[]
for i in range(120):
 s=''.join(str(random.randrange(10)) for _ in range(random.randint(3,7)))
 label=random.randrange(10)
 stem=f'Identifier: {s}\nLabel: {label}\n'
 items.append({'prompt':stem+'The first digit of the identifier is', 'answer':' '+s[0]})
 control.append({'prompt':stem+'The label digit is', 'answer':' '+str(label)})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
